messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [Pager] HIGH - autoscaler alert: hotpath GPU pool 'hotpath-v2' queue growth > 5k, 429 spike on hotpath routes. Incident: https://internal.incidents/3344556677
lex: seeing a ton of 429s from hosted API, spike started ~22:40 UTC. digging in.
ops_oncall: ack, i'm oncall. collecting metrics + contacting infra provisioning.
maya: autoscaler heartbeats delayed; last good hb 22:39:12 UTC, missed at 22:40:12. hotpath-v2 at 12/12 GPUs (capacity).
lex: controller logs show `insufficient_project_quota: GPUs` when trying to scale. suspect quota hit + autoscaler backoff.
ops_oncall: can you get queue length and 429 ratio?
maya: queue_len=8423, avg_completion_time=12.3s, 429_rate=37%, 5xx=0 for hotpath. spike consistent across regions.
lex: also noticed a tier policy change rolled at 00:00 that reduced token-bucket refill for hotpath. tight token bucket + pool full => immediate rejects instead of queuing.
dmitri: autoscaler entered backoff after the quota 403; controller shows backoff_until=22:55:00 (900s).
lex: mitigation plan: (A) temporary scale up hotpath pool if quota allows, (B) clear autoscaler backoff, (C) relax token-bucket for hotpath to allow queuing, (D) enable degraded cpu fallback for long-tail.
ops_oncall: executing commands now.
ops_oncall: `infra scale-gpu-pool --name hotpath-v2 --count 16 --reason "incident 3344556677 emergency scale"`
ops_oncall: `infra autoscaler-unblock --controller hotpath-v2 --force`
maya: scale command accepted; 3 new nodes provisioning (init). controller reconciling.
customer-success: CS seeing tickets from affected customers: cust-8471, cust-9923, & 4 others. triage in progress.
lex: patching tier policy to bump token refill from 100/s -> 600/s and window 1s -> 5s for hotpath.
lex: `config apply tier hotpath --token-refill 600 --window 5s` (applying now)
maya: token-bucket policy propagated to edge nodes (~20s). rejects dropping.
ops_oncall: new GPUs registering, pool at 15/16. queue draining: 8423 -> 1200 in ~4m.
dmitri: 429_rate down to 3%, avg_latency ~1.8s. no 5xx.
lex: enabling cpu fallback for long requests to reduce pressure on GPU hotpath. partial degraded responses for >30s tails.
anna: drafting comms to affected customers; will include mitigation summary and ETA.
ops_oncall: follow-ups: raise cloud GPU quota for prod project (quota prevented autoscaler); create infra ticket.
maya: created INFRA-1278 to request quota increase and track provisioning delays.
lex: assign owners: autoscaler backoff handling -> eng-sre (dmitri), token-bucket config + rollout policy -> platform (lex), quota raise -> cloud-adm (ops_oncall), customer comms -> customer-success (anna).
eng-sre: will take ownership of autoscaler backoff logic and follow up.
dmitri: will work on (1) reduce backoff on quota errors and (2) ensure controller can fall back to graceful degrade. opening PRs.
lex: runbook note: avoid aggressive token-bucket reductions during predicted peak windows; require canary rollout for tier changes.
ops_oncall: mitigation summary for incident log: scaled hotpath to 16 GPUs, cleared autoscaler backoff, relaxed token-bucket refill, enabled cpu fallback, drained queue. Limited customer impact after ~5 minutes. Full recovery at 22:53 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident state updated: MITIGATED. Please fill postmortem: https://confluence/incidents/3344556677
customer-success: all affected customers notified; a few requested SLA credits, CS to own follow-up.
lex: post-incident follow-ups: 1) alert on 3 missed autoscaler heartbeats, 2) autoscaler should not enter long backoff on quota errors, should attempt graceful degrade, 3) require review for any token-bucket policy change affecting hotpath in peak windows.
anna: i'll own customer comms + finalize postmortem draft.
maya: logs snippet for timeline:
```
2026-03-14T22:40:12Z controller: reconcile failed: insufficient_project_quota: GPUs
2026-03-14T22:40:12Z autoscaler: entering backoff for 900s
2026-03-14T22:41:05Z edge: tokenbucket reject: route=hotpath, tokens_left=0
```
ops_oncall: tagging incident SEV2 -> SEV1 at paging, returned to SEV2 after mitigation.
incident-bot: oncall handoff recorded: ops_oncall -> eng-sre at 22:55 UTC.
eng-sre: ack, taking handoff. will monitor queue and autoscaler metrics for next 2h and post updates here.
lex: thanks all, will schedule 1h postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC. :heart:
ops_oncall: moving to handoff; leaving sticky notes in runbook.
